result_summary: ScienceFlow gives strong exact archived-node identity, content-addressed workspace snapshots, exception rollback, tool-call resume and atomic resource-state storage, but the public implementation does not yet establish semantic equivalence across arbitrary process death during ESTRA. pending_estra is in-memory; no durable ESTRA transaction/startup reconciler was found binding intended controller action, workspace restore phase, lineage, charged budget and evaluation-consumption cursor. Parallel task budget state is also less crash-robust than UnifiedResourceStore. The resulting design hypothesis is a proof-carrying recovery transaction plus kill-point equivalence testing.
blocker: No public whole-system experiment found yet that simultaneously provides a matched Continue/clean-restart/artifact-preserving-rewind/strategy-redirect comparison under equal proposal/evaluation budget, complete action chronology, restart-equivalence evidence and a selection-unused outer test.
exact_next_action: Search public self-improving-agent systems for explicit kill-injection/restart-equivalence binding controller decision, exact artifact identity, charged budget and evaluation-consumption state. In parallel find a common-budget multi-action controller ablation comparing Continue, clean restart, artifact-preserving restart/ancestor rewind and strategy redirect under a selection-unused outer test; otherwise decompose the missing composition into transaction durability, recovery-action value and evaluation-consumption equivalence. Retain candidate-local anytime-valid promotion, proposal-crossing durable statistical spending, bounded selection-feedback bandwidth, immutable promotion identity and complete chronology as separate unresolved requirements.
